title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: Roman classic: eggs, pecorino, guanciale and lots of pepper. No cream.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil.
While it heats, whisk the eggs, yolk, pecorino and black pepper in a bowl.
Cook the guanciale in a dry pan over medium heat until crisp.
Cook the spaghetti until one minute short of al dente.
Off the heat, toss the pasta with the guanciale and a splash of pasta water, then stir in the egg mixture fast.
Serve right away with more pecorino and pepper.
